{{MissingInfo|2|java|enva}} [[File:Kylan.png|thumb|250px|Kylan]] '''Kylan''' (Japanese: '''ケンソー''' ''Kensō'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW077|Evolution by Fire!]]''. He was first seen in a [[Battle Club]] in [[Astilbe Town]], battling in a [[Double Battle]] with [[Shamus]]. After he lost, Kylan was later cornered by Shamus, who told him that he had to give him his Pokémon. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} intervened and kept Shamus busy long enough for [[Don George]] to walk by, deterring him from taking Kylan's Pokémon. Kylan explained to the group that he was forced to battle Shamus because he was afraid of his Pokémon. {{-}} ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Kylan |pkmn=Mienshao |img=Kylan Mienshao.png |type1=Fighting |epnum=BW077 |epname=Evolution by Fire! |vaen=Tom Wayland |desc={{p|Mienshao}} was used by Kylan in a Double Battle against Shamus's {{p|Emboar}} and {{p|Heatmor}}, partnered with {{p|Watchog}}. It managed to attack Heatmor with Drain Punch, but was knocked out, along with Watchog, when it was attacked by Emboar's {{m|Hammer Arm}}, then Heatmor's {{m|Flame Burst}}. Mienshao's only known move is {{m|Drain Punch}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Kylan |pkmn=Watchog |img=Kylan Watchog.png |type1=Normal |epnum=BW077 |epname=Evolution by Fire! |vaen=Tom Wayland |desc={{p|Watchog}} was used by Kylan in a Double Battle against Shamus's {{p|Emboar}} and {{p|Heatmor}}, partnered with Mienshao. It managed to attack Emboar with Slam, but was knocked out, along with Mienshao, when it was attacked by Emboar's {{m|Hammer Arm}}, then Heatmor's {{m|Flame Burst}}. Watchog's only known move is {{m|Slam}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{fighting color}}|bordercolor={{normal color light}} |ja=大谷育江 ''[[Ikue Otani]]'' |en= |cs=Petr Neskusil |fi=Susa Saukko |fr_eu=Delphine Chauvier |it=Renata Bertolas |pt_br=Silas Borges |es_eu=Miriam Valencia |pl=Grzegorz Drojewski }} ==Trivia== * Kylan is the first character introduced in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]'' whose English name was not revealed in the dub itself; instead, it was given in the closed captioning.
